actions.description: Grants permission to authenticate to the AWS Management Console

actions.description: Grants permission to authenticate through a browser and obtain an OAuth 2.0 authorization code for credential exchange
actions.name: AuthorizeOAuth2Access

actions.description: Grants permission to create an AWS account through the AWS Management Console sign-up flow
actions.name: CreateAccount

actions.description: Grants permission to dynamically register an OAuth 2.0 public client for use with AWS Sign-In

actions.description: Grants permission to exchange an authorization code for OAuth 2.0 access token and refresh token that can be used to access AWS services from developer tools and applications
actions.name: CreateOAuth2Token

actions.description: Grants permission to create an Identity Center application that represents the AWS Management Console on an Identity Center organization instance

actions.description: Grants permission to disable console authorization configuration for an AWS account or organization

actions.description: Grants permission to remove a permission statement from the account's SignIn Resource Based Policy

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve console authorization configuration for an AWS account or organization

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve SignIn Resource Based Policy document that is attached with your account
